See the GNU General Public License + * version 2 for more details (a copy is included in the LICENSE file that + * accompanied this code). + * + * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License version + * 2 along with this work; if not, write to the Free Software Foundation, + * Inc., 51 Franklin St, Fifth Floor, Boston, MA 02110-1301 USA. + * + * Please contact Oracle, 500 Oracle Parkway, Redwood Shores, CA 94065 USA + * or visit www.oracle.com if you need additional information or have any + * questions. + */ + +package test.com.sun.javafx.fxml.builder; + +import javafx.beans.NamedArg; + +import java.util.ArrayList; +import java.util.List; + +/** + * Fixture class for testing the {@code ArrayListWrapper} unwrapping path in + * {@code ProxyBuilder}. + * + *

The combination of a plain {@code List} getter (not {@code ObservableList}) + * and a {@code @NamedArg} constructor parameter of a non-collection type for the + * same property name exercises the branch in {@code getUserValue} that + * unwraps the first element of the temporary {@code ArrayListWrapper} container. + * + *

This mirrors what the FXML loader does when it encounters: + * 

{@code
+ * 
+ *     
+ *         
+ *     
+ * 
+ * }
+ */ +public class ClassWithPlainCollectionAndScalarArg { + + public final String child; + private final List childList = new ArrayList<>(); + + public ClassWithPlainCollectionAndScalarArg(@NamedArg("child") String child) { + this.child = child; + } + + public List getChild() { + return childList; + } +}

+<!--
+    Exercises the ArrayListWrapper unwrapping path in ProxyBuilder.getUserValue.
+
+    The class has a plain List<String> getter named "child" (not ObservableList),
+    so ProxyBuilder creates an ArrayListWrapper as the temporary accumulation container.
+    The @NamedArg constructor parameter "child" has type String (a scalar), so
+    getUserValue must detect the ArrayListWrapper and extract its first element.
+-->
+<?import java.lang.String?>
+<?import test.com.sun.javafx.fxml.builder.ClassWithPlainCollectionAndScalarArg?>
+<ClassWithPlainCollectionAndScalarArg xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml">
+    <child>
+        <String fx:value="hello"/>
+    </child>
+</ClassWithPlainCollectionAndScalarArg>
